
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(edgeR)

tds_genes = c(
  "DIO1", "DIO2", "DUOX1", "DUOX2",
  "FOXE1", "GLIS3", "NKX2-1", "PAX8",
  "SLC26A4", "SLC5A5", "SLC5A8", "TG",
  "TPO", "TSHR", "THRA", "THRB"
)

tumor_samples = read.csv(
  "data/1tumor_samples_final_68.csv"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, group) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  mutate(tissue_type_simple = "Tumor")

normal_samples = read.csv(
  "data/1normal_samples_final_32.csv"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, group) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  mutate(tissue_type_simple = "Normal")

all_samples = bind_rows(
  tumor_samples,
  normal_samples
)

rna = read.csv(
  "data/raw rna/thyroid_rna_counts_112.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

missing_samples = setdiff(
  tumor_samples$sample_id,
  colnames(rna)
)

rna_all = rna %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ensembl,
    dplyr::all_of(all_samples$sample_id)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ensembl") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(rna_all) = "numeric"
```

```{r}
dge_all = edgeR::DGEList(
  counts = rna_all
)

dge_all = edgeR::calcNormFactors(
  dge_all,
  method = "TMM"
)

log_rna_all = edgeR::cpm(
  dge_all,
  log = TRUE,
  prior.count = 1
)
```

```{r}
gene_map = readRDS(
  "data/ensembl115_gene_map.rds"
)

log_rna_all_df = as.data.frame(
  log_rna_all,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "ensembl_gene_id_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ensembl_gene_id = sub(
      "\\..*$",
      "",
      ensembl_gene_id_raw
    )
  )

tds_gene_map <- gene_map %>%
  transmute(
    ensembl_gene_id = sub(
      "\\..*$",
      "",
      ensembl_gene_id
    ),
    hgnc_symbol = trimws(hgnc_symbol)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(hgnc_symbol),
    hgnc_symbol != "",
    hgnc_symbol %in% tds_genes
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    ensembl_gene_id,
    hgnc_symbol
  )

tds_expression_mapped <- log_rna_all_df %>%
  inner_join(
    tds_gene_map,
    by = "ensembl_gene_id"
  )

tds_expression_mapped %>%
  dplyr::count(
    hgnc_symbol,
    sort = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
tds_expression_matrix = tds_expression_mapped %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hgnc_symbol,
    dplyr::all_of(all_samples$sample_id)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>%
  as.matrix()

tds_expression_matrix = tds_expression_matrix[
  tds_genes,
  all_samples$sample_id,
  drop = FALSE
]

storage.mode(tds_expression_matrix) <- "numeric"
```

```{r}
mean_tds_expression = colMeans(
  tds_expression_matrix,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

mean_tds_expression_df = tibble(
  sample_id = names(mean_tds_expression),
  mean_log2_expression = as.numeric(
    mean_tds_expression
  )
) %>%
  left_join(
    all_samples,
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "WTC-unexposed",
        "WTC-exposed"
      )
    ),
    tissue_type_simple = factor(
      tissue_type_simple,
      levels = c(
        "Tumor",
        "Normal"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
mean_tds_expression_df = mean_tds_expression_df %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "WTC-exposed",
        "WTC-unexposed"
      )
    )
  )

mean_expression_medians = mean_tds_expression_df %>%
  group_by(
    tissue_type_simple,
    group
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    median_expression = median(
      mean_log2_expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_label = paste0(
      "Median: ",
      round(median_expression, 2)
    )
  )

ggplot(
  mean_tds_expression_df,
  aes(
    x = group,
    y = mean_log2_expression,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = mean_expression_medians,
    aes(
      x = group,
      y = median_expression,
      label = median_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    nudge_x = 0.29,
    nudge_y = 0.02,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ tissue_type_simple
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "WTC-unexposed" = "dodgerblue4",
      "WTC-exposed" = "firebrick3"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.25)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Expression of Thyroid Differentiation Genes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean log2 Expression of TDS Genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 13,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey90",
      color = "black"
    ),
    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      1,
      "lines"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```
